title: The Vibe Marketing Playbook for 2026 | Sprites
summary: Vibe marketing means describing the campaign you want and letting AI agents build, test, and optimize it. Definition, real workflows, tools, and examples.
body_markdown:
What is vibe marketing?


Vibe marketing is describing the marketing outcome you want, in plain language, and having AI agents produce and run the work: creative, copy, targeting, launch and optimization. The marketer sets direction and approves; the agent does the production. The name mirrors vibe coding.


Is vibe marketing just AI marketing?


No. AI marketing is any use of AI in marketing, including a chatbot that drafts a caption. Vibe marketing is a way of working: the agent operates inside the real systems (the ad account, the CMS) and proposes changes you approve, so the output is a live campaign rather than a document about one.


What tools do you need for vibe marketing?


Three layers: a language model to write and reason (ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini), something that turns its output into work in your accounts (an agent platform such as Sprites, or workflow tools like n8n, Make and Zapier), and analytics to see what happened. Creative generators such as Midjourney, Runway and HeyGen slot into the first layer.


Can one person do vibe marketing?


Yes, and that is the point. One marketer with an agent can research competitors, generate and launch variants, reallocate budget and publish articles in a week. What still needs a person is the offer, the voice, and which proposals to approve.


What is the difference between vibe marketing and vibe coding?


Same idea, different output. In vibe coding you describe software and the model writes code you accept or revise. In vibe marketing you describe a campaign and an agent builds and runs it. Both move the human from producing the work to directing and judging it.


How is vibe marketing different from marketing automation?


Marketing automation runs a workflow you designed in advance: if this, then that. Vibe marketing starts from the outcome and lets the agent decide the steps, then asks for approval before it acts. Automation is fixed; an agent adapts to what it finds in the account.


Does vibe marketing work for paid ads?


It works best there, because ad platforms expose everything an agent needs to read and change: spend, conversions, search terms, audiences, creative. A typical week is an audit, a budget reallocation, a batch of new variants and a review, each proposed by the agent and approved by you.
